faqs.question: What are Triggers in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Triggers automate customer communication through Email and WhatsApp based on a defined schedule or event.

faqs.question: What can I configure in a trigger?
faqs.answer: You can define when to send the message, who receives it, what it says, and which communication channel to use.

faqs.question: Can I send payment reminders automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. For example, you can set a trigger to send a payment reminder three days before an invoice's due date.

faqs.question: Is WhatsApp supported?
faqs.answer: Yes. WhatsApp triggers are supported when MSG91 integration is configured.
